source_hash_basis: git blobs at reviewed_commit; later fixes are outside this verdict

findings.finding: Root tree control sends an empty relative_path; frozen schema accepts dot for the root and requires nonempty RelativePath otherwise.
findings.minimum_verification: Click root tree and parent-to-root through the actual desktop bridge; assert relative_path is dot and the typed response is valid.

findings.finding: The first 100 session rows are consumed but next_cursor is discarded, making later sessions inaccessible through the picker.
findings.minimum_verification: Seed at least 101 authorized sessions, consume the next page and open its final session without cross-project leakage.

findings.requirement: 22 section 7: show the concrete action and scope before permission response
findings.finding: Permission panel presents only request.summary before sending ALLOW_ONCE or DENY; the frozen action_scope, paths, inputs, parameters reference and expiry are not presented.
findings.minimum_verification: Render schema-valid PermissionPrompt with distinguishing scope values; inspect the visible action, then verify current response and stale/expired refusals using original request identity. Do not infer that DENY is authorized when policy_allows_user_decision is false.

findings.requirement: 22 section 5.3; C26 cursor recovery via snapshot
findings.finding: UI automatically resets only CURSOR_EXPIRED while the current session.events handler returns CURSOR_INVALID for ErrResyncRequired. A same-session snapshot adoption does not reset the old eventSequence, so polling can remain stuck after a retention gap.
findings.minimum_verification: Return CURSOR_INVALID for the old cursor, verify snapshot recovery advances the local cursor and events resume without resending a write.

findings.requirement: 10 section 5 and W13-03 step 2: distinguish successful empty data from unavailable data
findings.finding: Failed session listing still states that there are no sessions; failed skill listing still states that there are no skill versions. Error and empty states are conflated.
findings.minimum_verification: Deny a list containing known records, assert unavailable rather than no-records text, then restore and verify the known records.

findings.requirement: 22 section 5.3 full transcript reference when messages are truncated; S01 accessible session history
findings.finding: has_earlier_messages shows an explanatory sentence but the UI offers no action using transcript_artifact_ref to open the full history.
findings.minimum_verification: A snapshot with more than 200 messages exposes and opens the exact full transcript artifact reference with its hash.

findings.requirement: W13-03 steps 1-2: all eight states and actionable recovery on all 11 screens
findings.finding: No independent empty scenario exists. partial is recorded without an assertion and may affect no relevant query. Recovery only checks absence of loading; an error page can satisfy that condition. Full navigation replaces the page instead of exercising its retry action and draft preservation.
findings.minimum_verification: Use a per-screen eight-state roster with actual expected records, selected query failures, visible partial results and recovery through UI controls; verify drafts and authoritative values after recovery.

findings.requirement: W13-03 step 1; S01 real session workspace interaction
findings.finding: The seed creates legacy domain objects but no typed session; the control is started without runtime coordinator configuration. S01 matrix screenshots therefore do not establish message, tool, permission or workspace-file interactions.
findings.minimum_verification: Exercise a real current host session and its visible transcript/tool/file controls, recording fixture versus real-service boundaries explicitly.

findings.requirement: W13-03 step 3; 10 section 6: keyboard/focus, basic screen reader, contrast, reduced motion and mobile targets
findings.finding: Accessibility checks search for heading/navigation in an ARIA snapshot and press Tab once. The matrix does not measure rendered contrast, reduced-motion behavior, 44px targets or actual basic screen-reader operation. Its screen-reader limitation is honestly disclosed but does not satisfy the missing required check.
findings.minimum_verification: Measure rendered color pairs and target bounds, exercise keyboard actions and focus return, set reduced motion, and record one actual basic screen-reader pass.

findings.requirement: W13-03 step 4: actual no-script/no-remote preview and oversize fallback with raw screenshot and DOM evidence
findings.finding: The Electron matrix never opens previews or downloads. Static implementation includes sandbox, CSP, hash checks and a 5 MiB fallback, so this is an execution-evidence gap, not a confirmed preview security exploit.
findings.minimum_verification: Use nonprotected synthetic HTML/Markdown/image/PDF and oversize content in the real Desktop; measure script effects, remote requests, visible prompt and downloaded exact bytes.

retracted_or_not_established.claim: location.origin=null makes all internal navigation fail
retracted_or_not_established.reason: Node URL behavior does not establish Chromium behavior for the registered ros-app scheme. Actual link interaction must decide this; no confirmed defect asserted.
22 section 7 requires current authority to permit a user decision; the UI flag alone does not establish that a DENY request remains authorized. No recommendation to bypass policy gating.

verification_performed: Read committed frontend, matrix, host protocol and frozen contracts.
Inspected WorkspaceTreePayload root const dot and RelativePath minLength 1.
Compared actual server CURSOR_INVALID mapping to frontend recovery branches.
verification_not_performed: Reviewer did not rerun the Electron matrix or operate the native folder chooser.
Reviewer did not perform actual screen-reader, rendered-contrast or preview-network measurements.
No external provider request, protected holdout read or production database operation.
mode_interpretation: DEVELOPMENT is permitted for this card when required actual Desktop interactions and recovery checks pass; explicit contract FIXTURE backends are permitted for unfinished experiment/Jev/skill surfaces. This does not waive primary frontend behavior or claim W20 full integration.
independence: Reviewer did not implement the reviewed W13-03 source. Earlier unrelated runtime/domain work is not used as independent acceptance for this card.
writes_authorized: Only this new review receipt; no source, frozen gate, prior receipt or step_state modifications.
